posts.text: 6d You made it easy for ChatGPT, Grok and Claude to recommend your store & it’s products.. But can AI buy from your store? 1 in 20 shoppers let an AI agent shop for them… A human whose card gets declined tries again. But an AI agent skips you for the next store if the payment declines at the checkout or if it hits a forced signup. And that is how you lose the order. ——————- In 2026, checkout customization and funnel have been an everywhere conversation in the ecom space. VISA and Mastercard have tightened the rules of chargebacks and refunds. Now AI vs human shoppers. It has never been so easy, yet never been so hard. Are you prepared for this new wave of buyers?
